questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical enforcement of cluster security drift using policy as code, ensuring consistent runtime guards across tenants.

## Key Concepts
- Gatekeeper policy design (ConstraintTemplate, Constraint)
- Enforcement of privileged, hostPath, runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, capabilities
- Validation of policy with compliant/noncompliant pods
- Zero-downtime rollout of policy changes

## Code Example
```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate: K8sSecurityPolicy
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8ssecuritypolicy
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sSecurityPolicy
  targets:
  - target:AdmissionReview
    code: |
      package k8ssecuritypolicy
      violation["msg"] = msg { true }
      msg = "Policy violation: privileged hostPath or unsafe securityContext"
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test policy impact on CI/CD workflows?
- How do you audit existing resources for drift post-policy rollout?

## Why This Is Asked

- Delta Lake schema evolution and compatibility modes

- Canary/blue-green deployment and rollback strategies
- Data quality validation using synthetic test datasets
- Cross-platform consumption across Snowflake and Databricks

## Code Example
```sql
-- Add nullable column

-- Enable schema auto-evolution for seamless writes
SET spark.sql.streaming.schemaEvolution = true;

-- Restore to previous version if needed
RESTORE TABLE delta.`/path/to/table` TO VERSION AS OF <previous_version>;
```

- Cross-region replication lag and cache coherence
- Canary/blue-green rollout across clusters
- Telemetry-driven latency guarantees (P95) and rollback safety

```bash
# Check flag propagation
redis-cli -h redis-primary -p 6379 GET FLAG_X
curl -s http://flag-service.default.svc.cluster.local/flags/FLAG_X
```

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: kcsa-flag
spec:
  hosts:
  - kcsa.example.com
  http:
  - route:
    - destination:
        host: kcsa-frontend

    - destination:
```
